title: diphasiastrum alpinum
intro: Diphasiastrum alpinum, commonly known as Alpine club moss, is a species of club moss that belongs to the genus Diphasiastrum. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alpine club moss include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Diphasiastrum alpinum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
